gen-gf-autour-one-fs-familjen-grotesk: Expressive and round-lettered, Autour One draws every stroke with a single fixed nib. Familjen Grotesk follows with tall lowercase and bowls left open on one side, so paragraphs of it move along lightly.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Wide, confident capitals with round forms like open parentheses. And Pilcrow Rounded packs its tall lowercase tightly, with big counters and curves that never quite close, so a long passage feels warm and easy.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-arvo: Oswald packs its rows of text into tight, confident lines. Arvo then takes over with a dignified serif voice and curves that stay open, so a long passage reads in a traditional, unhurried way.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-hind: Metamorphous sets generous space around every high-waisted letter. Hind brings an unmodulated line and lowercase close to capital height, and that stroke consistency is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-familjen: Familjen Grotesk reads lively and tall in the lowercase, with bowls left unfinished on one side. And Love Ya Like A Sister sits above it in true monoline strokes, so a larger heading size gives that outward-pointing hand room.
gen-gf-offside-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Offside spreads its commanding letters wide, with a quiet level beat and curves that never close. Pilcrow Rounded matches that openness in a tighter, warmer sans-serif, and the shared unclosed curves are what tie them.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-hind: Paprika scatters its letters wide and loose. Hind answers with arches that match their stems and a sans-serif line of steady strokes, and that firm tidiness is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans reads sturdy and large, its tall lowercase and clearly open e making words feel solid. Revalia's wide, relaxed letters then lead the page above it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-hind: Bold stencil bridges give Snowburst One its spiky, expressive look. But Hind keeps the page grounded, with strokes of steady width and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-alpino: Tektur gives its outsized lowercase a pipe-cleaner hum, with generous openings on every curve and constant line weight. Alpino is the cozy one, tall and tightly spaced for running text.
